scope: Linux source desktop with six synthetic 7500-line TypeScript editors, synthetic attribution/diff and a controlled formatter over the actual bridge. CDP post-renderer-diagnostic-GC isolate heap plus detached-debugger Linux process-tree PSS/private-page samples; no main/worker-isolate forced GC, system/GPU/model accounting or general app speed claim. Resume timings include the real bridge and polling, stop at DOM plus parser availability and do not establish paint completion. WeakMap identities deliberately do not pin views during measurement. Private cmTile/debug tree getter and own blame-field shape are version-pinned diagnostics only.
